<thought>To determine the number of methyl (CH₃) groups, I need the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample. Methyl carbons appear in the upfield region (~10‑30 ppm). By retrieving the carbon NMR data, I can count the distinct signals in that region, which corresponds to the number of methyl groups.</thought>
